title: XFX AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT Swift OC Dual Fan Gaming Edition 16GB Graphics Card $588.30 Delivered @ Mwave
body:
Deal: XFX AMD Radeon RX 9060 XT Swift OC Dual Fan Gaming Edition 16GB Graphics Card $588.30 Delivered @ Mwave

[Billybob94111] Will stack with amex $30 cashback for purchases over $300?
[bruhminister] No reason why it shouldn't. Unless it's in Amex tnc.
[digitalaxon] I bought the black version about 2 months ago - wasn't sure what to expect being a 2 fan card, but happy to report the large heatsink and the fan curve on these cards is nice - unlike asus 3 fan cards that start at 800-900 rpm, this card starts around 400 rpm and for me stays around 600-700 playing games as I enable vsync at 60hz.
[panda1010101] I have this card. If you would like lower temps, and because of that lower fan rpm, I suggest undervolting your GPU.
Here’s a guide on how to do this for the Rx 9060 xt: https://m.youtube.com/watch?v=rOuPNSYD918
[leeroys_dad] I really want one but don't think I need to upgrade the 3rd and 4th spare PCs with 5700xt 8gb
[AnKu] On par with 5060Ti, I reckon. It can handle lots of AAA games at 1080p/1440p on high settings with ease.
[Outsider] For those wondering Mwave have already jacked up all their prices to cover this "discount" and then some.
Not worth going to their website.
[bunnybash] Price is now over 800 dollars. Damn. This is just ridiculous. Duck it I’m out. Gaming and computers are just dead to me.
[MrZ] Damn, wish I got one to flip on marketplace.
[Aliensf] Its the same price I paid for my 9070XT.
